Maintenance release. No changes to plugin behavior.

- Fix `npm publish --dry-run` so it runs the full package check
- Update development dependencies (TypeScript 7, `@types/bun` 1.4.2)
- Release from a local clone; document the steps in the README

Published to npm as [`@mhayden/opencode-mythos-plugin@0.1.1`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mhayden/opencode-mythos-plugin/v/0.1.1).

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): update dependency @types/bun to v1.4.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/major/opencode-mythos-plugin/pull/3
* chore(deps): update dependency typescript to v7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/major/opencode-mythos-plugin/pull/5
* chore(deps): lock file maintenance by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/major/opencode-mythos-plugin/pull/6


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/major/opencode-mythos-plugin/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1

Initial release of the unofficial Mythos provider plugin for OpenCode V2.

- Registers a `mythos` provider that uses your `ant` CLI profile login
- Mirrors the built-in Anthropic model catalog with matching pricing and limits
- Published to npm as [`@mhayden/opencode-mythos-plugin@0.1.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mhayden/opencode-mythos-plugin/v/0.1.0)

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the OpenCode project or Anthropic.
